name: Him Teknoforge Limited
about: Him Teknoforge Limited engages in the manufacture, marketing, distribution, and sale of automotive, non-automotive, and engineering components in India and internationally. The company offers machined components, such as gears and shafts, assemblies and sub-assemblies, gear boxes, PTO assemblies, axles, crown and bevel wheel kits, fork-lift parts, and kingpins and repair kits; other auto parts, including suspension linkage parts, B.C. levers, steering levers, output flanges, shifter forks and selector shafts, axle tube nuts, and propeller shaft components; and e- vehicles. It also provides forging services for agri machineries, commercial vehicles, railways, and oil and gas industries. The company was formerly known as Gujarat Automotive Gears Limited and changed its name to Him Teknoforge Limited in March 2018. Him Teknoforge Limited was incorporated in 1971 and is headquartered in Solan, India.
